hero.title: ECHOES OF FREEDOM
hero.subtitle: 79 Years of Resilience, Heritage, and Progress

genesis.tributeText: At midnight, a new nation found its voice. From Lahore, across a waiting subcontinent, the words that mattered most were simple: a free Pakistan had begun.
genesis.caption: A tribute moment marking the birth of Pakistan, 14th August 1947.

punjab.title: Punjab
punjab.description: Home to Multani blue pottery and the timeless folklore of Heer Ranjha, Punjab's craft traditions blend Mughal-era ceramics with a living oral storytelling culture that still shapes its villages and cities today.

sindh.title: Sindh
sindh.craft: Ajrak Block Printing & Ancient Mohenjo-Daro Heritage
sindh.description: From the ancient streets of Mohenjo-Daro to the geometric block-printed patterns of Ajrak, Sindh carries one of the subcontinent's oldest continuous craft and civilizational traditions.

kpk.title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
kpk.description: Peshawar's copper and brasswork artisans have shaped intricate household art for generations, while the Rabab's acoustic tradition keeps the region's musical heritage alive.

balochistan.title: Balochistan
balochistan.description: Balochi needlework embroidery — vivid, hand-stitched, and deeply symbolic — mirrors the rugged beauty of a coastal and mountainous landscape unlike anywhere else in the country.

gb_kashmir.title: Gilgit-Baltistan & Kashmir
gb_kashmir.description: Walnut wood carving and Pashmina weaving traditions have thrived for centuries in the shadow of the world's highest peaks, carrying craftsmanship shaped by altitude and patience.

milestones.title: Milestones of 79 Years
milestones.subtitle: A Journey Through Decades of Resilience, Culture & Innovation

timeline.title: Foundations & Vision
timeline.description: Pakistan lays its architectural and institutional foundations — Minar-e-Pakistan rises in Lahore, and Islamabad is planned and built as a new capital, symbolizing a young nation designing its own future.

timeline.title: Golden Era of Culture & Sport
timeline.description: A cultural golden era — PTV dramas become a shared national experience, and in 1992 Pakistan lifts the Cricket World Cup, uniting the country in celebration.

timeline.title: Digital Awakening & Youth Energy
timeline.description: A generation comes of age online — telecom and internet access expand rapidly, and Pakistani youth begin building startups, media, and creative work with global reach.

timeline.title: Innovation & Global Reach
timeline.description: A new wave of tech, design, and entrepreneurial energy — from freelancers to founders — continues to reshape how the world sees Pakistani talent.

timeline.title: 79th Independence Day
timeline.description: Seventy-nine years on, the story continues to be written — not just by history, but by every generation choosing to carry it forward.

wishes: Here's to a Pakistan we keep building, together.
Proud of where we've come from. Excited for where we're going.
Chhote chhote kaam se bhi mulk ban'ta hai — apna hissa daalte rahenge.

footer.note: This tribute was built with care, for a country still writing its story — 79 years in, and counting.
